title: carex macroura subsp. kirilovii

This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Carex macroura subsp. kirilovii include its potential to treat various conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and fever, as well as its use as a diuretic to help with urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
